label: CONNECTION

cover.headline: 5 tiny rituals that *keep a marriage warm*
cover.sub: Small, repeatable, and easy to start this week.

points.heading: A real goodbye
points.body: Before either of you leaves, take ten seconds. A hug, a kiss, a “have a good one.”
points.panel: No leaving without a proper goodbye.

points.heading: The daily check-in
points.body: Five minutes at the same time each day. One good thing and one hard thing, each.
points.panel: “What was your high and your low today?”

points.heading: One meal, no screens
points.body: It doesn’t have to be every meal. Pick one and protect it.
points.panel: Phones stay off the table at dinner.

points.heading: A weekly “us” time
points.body: Put it on the calendar the way you would any other commitment. It counts as one.
points.panel: “Sunday evenings are ours. What should we do?”

points.heading: Say goodnight on purpose
points.body: End the day facing each other for a moment, even after a hard one.

close.save: Save this and pick one to start.

caption:
Big gestures get the attention. Small routines quietly do a lot of the work.

A ritual is just a kind thing you do on repeat, so neither of you has to remember to make the effort. Pick one of these five and try it for a week before adding another.
